units.source_text: 中将君又说：“他甚至对老尼姑弁君说，要找寻这个微不足数的浮舟去赡养，

en.t: Chujo no Kimi added, "He even told the old nun Ben no Kimi that he wanted to seek out this insignificant Ukifune and provide for her,

units.source_text: 作为大小姐的替身呢。

en.t: as a substitute for the elder princess.

units.source_text: 此事我当然不敢妄想，但这也是为了‘一枝紫草’的缘故，

en.t: Of course I would never dare hope for such a thing, but this too is because of that 'single sprig of murasaki,'

units.source_text: 虽然万不敢当，其深切关怀之情甚可感激。”

en.t: and though it is far more than we deserve, his deep concern is truly something to be grateful for."

units.source_text: 就乘便谈到她为浮舟操心之苦痛，说时声泪俱下。

en.t: She then took the opportunity to speak of the pain of worrying over Ukifune, and as she spoke her voice broke and tears fell.

units.source_text: 关于左近少将欺负浮舟之事，既然外人都已知道，

en.t: Since even outsiders already knew about Sakon no Shosho's mistreatment of Ukifune,

units.source_text: 她也约略向二女公子谈及，但不甚详细。

en.t: she mentioned it briefly to the Second Princess as well, though not in much detail.

units.source_text: 她说：“只要我活在世间，怕什么呢！

en.t: She said, "As long as I am alive in this world, what is there to fear?

units.source_text: 我可和她相伴，互相慰藉而共度岁月。

en.t: I can stay beside her, comfort each other, and pass the years together.

units.source_text: 所可虑者，我死之后，她遭逢意外之灾，

en.t: What worries me is that after I die, she may meet with some unforeseen calamity,

units.source_text: 弄得颠沛流离，那真是可悲的了。

en.t: and be reduced to wandering in hardship; that would truly be pitiful.

units.source_text: 因此我在忧愁苦闷之时，不免想起：

en.t: So when I am sunk in grief and distress, I cannot help thinking:

units.source_text: 索性让她当了尼姑，闭居深山，专修佛法，

en.t: perhaps I should simply have her become a nun, shut herself away deep in the mountains, and devote herself solely to the Buddhist path,

units.source_text: 从此断绝尘缘吧。”

en.t: cutting off all worldly ties from then on."

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“你的处境确是困苦。

en.t: The Second Princess said, "Your circumstances are indeed painful.

units.source_text: 然而无可奈何。

en.t: Yet there is nothing to be done.

units.source_text: 受人欺侮，是我们这种孤儿分内之事呀！

en.t: For orphans like us, being looked down on by others is only to be expected.

units.source_text: 不过闭居深山，毕竟不是办法。

en.t: Still, shutting oneself away deep in the mountains is not really a solution.

units.source_text: 像我，本已决心遵照父亲遗嘱，断绝尘缘，

en.t: As for me, I had already resolved to follow my father's dying wish and sever my ties with the world,

units.source_text: 然而也会遭逢这种意外之变，在这里随俗沉浮。

en.t: yet even I met with this unexpected turn of events and now drift along here with worldly ways.

units.source_text: 何况这浮舟妹妹，哪里做得到呢？

en.t: How could this younger sister Ukifune possibly manage it?

units.source_text: 花朵一般的人，穿了尼僧服装多可惜啊！”

en.t: What a pity it would be for someone like a flower to wear a nun's robes!"

units.source_text: 这是老成持重之言，中将君听了非常欣喜。

en.t: These were mature and prudent words, and Chujo no Kimi was very pleased to hear them.

units.source_text: 这中将君年纪虽已不小，但因出身高贵，

en.t: This Chujo no Kimi was no longer young, but because she was of noble birth,

units.source_text: 气度仍很优雅。

en.t: her bearing was still very elegant.

units.source_text: 只是身体过分肥胖，俨然是一位常陆守夫人。

en.t: Only her body had grown excessively stout, making her look every bit like the wife of the Governor of Hitachi.

units.source_text: 她说：“已故八亲王无情无义，不认浮舟为女儿，

en.t: She said, "The late Eighth Prince was heartless and refused to acknowledge Ukifune as his daughter,

units.source_text: 使得她脸上无光，受人怠慢。

en.t: so she lost all standing and was slighted by others.

units.source_text: 现在能和您通问见面，往日的苦恨也消释了。”

en.t: Now that she can exchange messages with you and meet you, the bitterness of former days has also faded."

units.source_text: 就对她罄谈过去多年来在外地的生活，

en.t: She then poured out to her the whole story of her many years of life in distant provinces,

units.source_text: 也谈到陆奥地方浮岛的美景。

en.t: and also spoke of the beautiful scenery of Ukishima in the Michinoku region.

units.source_text: 她说：“我在筑波山下的生涯，真所谓‘惟我一身多苦患’，

en.t: She said, "My life at the foot of Mount Tsukuba was truly, as the saying goes, 'my single self burdened with many sorrows,'

units.source_text: 无人可与共话。

en.t: with no one at all to share my thoughts with.

units.source_text: 今天我才得把这情况向您罄诉了。

en.t: Only today have I finally been able to tell you everything about it.

units.source_text: 我很想永远住在您身旁。

en.t: I would very much like to live beside you forever.

units.source_text: 只是那边还有许多讨厌的孩子，不知何等喧哗扰攘地在寻找母亲，

en.t: But back there are many troublesome children, and who knows what a commotion they are making as they search for their mother,

units.source_text: 故我长久躲在这里毕竟是不放心的。

en.t: so in the end I cannot feel at ease hiding here for long.

units.source_text: 我沦落为地方官的妻子，常痛惜自身命苦，

en.t: Having fallen so low as to become the wife of a provincial official, I often grieve over my own harsh fate,

units.source_text: 不愿叫浮舟蹈我覆辙。

en.t: and I do not want Ukifune to follow in my footsteps.

units.source_text: 所以想把这孩子托付与您，听凭您处置，我概不闻问。”

en.t: That is why I want to entrust this child to you, leave everything to your judgment, and never interfere."

units.source_text: 二女公子听了她这番愁诉，也觉得不忍叫浮舟受苦。

en.t: After hearing this sorrowful appeal, the Second Princess also felt that she could not bear to let Ukifune suffer.

units.source_text: 浮舟原也生得品貌兼优，无可指摘。

en.t: Ukifune herself was naturally excellent in both appearance and character, with nothing to criticize.

units.source_text: 腼腆含羞，但不十分做作；

en.t: She was shy and bashful, but not overly affected;

units.source_text: 像孩子一般天真，却又很有见识。

en.t: she was innocent like a child, yet also showed good judgment.

units.source_text: 她见了二女公子的贴身侍女，也巧妙地躲避。

en.t: When she saw the Second Princess's personal attendants, she skillfully kept out of their way.

units.source_text: 二女公子忽然想道：“她说话时，语调也酷肖姐姐。

en.t: The Second Princess suddenly thought, "When she speaks, even the tone of her voice is very much like my elder sister's.

units.source_text: 我想叫找求姐姐雕像的那个人来看看呢。”

en.t: I would like to call the man who is searching for my sister's statue and let him see her."
